Record Class Compilation

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
be.imgn.gaia.processing.testing.Compilation
Record Components:
success - whether javac reported no error
diagnostics - every diagnostic, in reporting order
generatedFiles - every generated file, named /<LOCATION>/<relative path>, such as /SOURCE_OUTPUT/example/FooInfo.java or /CLASS_OUTPUT/example/Foo.class
public record Compilation(boolean success, List<Diagnostic<? extends JavaFileObject>> diagnostics, List<JavaFileObject> generatedFiles) extends Record
The outcome of a TestCompiler run: whether it succeeded, every diagnostic, and every generated file.

Assert on it with CompilationAssert.assertThat(Compilation).

    • generatedFile

      public Optional<JavaFileObject> generatedFile(JavaFileManager.Location location, String relativePath)
      Returns a generated file.
      Parameters:
      location - the location the file was generated in, such as StandardLocation.CLASS_OUTPUT
      relativePath - the path of the file relative to the location, separated by /
      Returns:
      the file, or empty if none was generated there
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if relativePath is empty or starts with /

    • equals

      public final boolean equals(Object o)
      Indicates whether some other object is "equal to" this one. The objects are equal if the other object is of the same class and if all the record components are equal. Reference components are compared with Objects::equals(Object,Object); primitive components are compared with the compare method from their corresponding wrapper classes.
      Specified by:
      equals in class Record
      Parameters:
      o - the object with which to compare
      Returns:
      true if this object is the same as the o argument; false otherwise.
